subject: Hypothetical Absence of Gravity
overview: The hosts recorded the first episode of the Freaking Out on Science podcast to explore a world without gravity. The discussion included comedic claims about scientific history and a promotional message.

items.title: Podcast Introduction
items.summary: The show opens with an introduction to the comedy podcast premise alongside cast credits.

items.title: Absence of Gravity
items.summary: Co-hosts Joe, Adam, and Dan pose the episode question regarding what would happen if gravity ceased to exist.

items.title: Sponsor Announcement
items.summary: A promotional advertisement is read for sponsor Spatula City.

items.title: Discussion on Gravity and Historical Figures
items.summary: The participants present comedic theories regarding Isaac Newton, Nikola Tesla, and Frederick Douglass before concluding the episode.
